Actions.Name: Fleet Pulse
Actions.Tooltip: Live T3 Code fleet counts. Short press: focus highest-priority thread (or inspect pending approval/question). Hold: open Fleet Switchboard.

Actions.Name: Approve / Answer
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: open 2-step Panoramic Approval Inspector or Question Responder. Hold: approve for session.

Actions.Name: Stop / Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: decline pending approval or interrupt active run. Hold: force-stop thread.

Actions.Name: Settle / Pin
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: toggle Settle on focused thread. Hold: open Thread Tools drawer (Pin, Unread, PR, Stop, Snooze).

Actions.Name: New Chat
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: create and open a new chat in the active project. Hold: open 4-knob Cockpit New Chat Builder.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Scrub AI Next & quick prompt presets

Actions.Name: Send / Steer Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: send/steer configured prompt. Hold: open Quick Prompts drawer with live AI-predicted next prompt. Dial: scrub & send prompts.

Actions.Name: Open Thread / PR
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: focus thread in T3 Code. Hold: open linked Pull Request.

Actions.Name: Snooze / Sync
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: snooze with your default T3 preset (or unsnooze). Hold: open all T3 snooze presets + custom dial scrubber. Dial: scrub & apply presets.

Actions.Name: Thread Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Displays and opens the thread at this key's auto-numbered slot index.

TriggerDescription.Push: Open focused thread in T3 Code
TriggerDescription.Touch: Cycle filter (Active / Attention / Running / Pinned / All)

Actions.Name: Thread Navigator
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: scrub threads. Key: tap to step to next thread, hold to open Fleet Switchboard.

TriggerDescription.Push: Apply selected model (or hold/press when idle to toggle Favorites vs All)
TriggerDescription.Rotate: Browse Favorite models (or All models when toggled)
TriggerDescription.Touch: Apply selected model (or tap when idle to toggle Favorites vs All)

Actions.Name: Model & Provider
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: scrub & apply models. Key: tap to open Model Picker overlay, hold to toggle Favorites vs All.

TriggerDescription.Push: Cycle runtime mode (Ask / Edits / Auto / Full)

Actions.Name: Mode & Effort
Actions.Tooltip: Dial: adjust effort, runtime mode, and Plan Mode. Key: tap to open Mode & Effort picker, hold to toggle Plan Mode.

Actions.Name: Usage Radar
Actions.Tooltip: Live session and weekly utilization gauges across all connected T3 Code providers. Key: tap to cycle, hold to refresh.

TriggerDescription.Push: Start or stop T3 built-in voice STT
TriggerDescription.Touch: Start or stop T3 built-in voice STT

Actions.Name: Voice Prompt (STT)
Actions.Tooltip: Speak directly to the focused T3 Code thread using T3's built-in streaming STT (/ws/voice). Tap to toggle, hold for Push-to-Talk, review draft & SEND.

Author: Charles Bine
Description: Real-time T3 Code mission control for Elgato Stream Deck (+, + XL, MK.2, XL, Neo, Mini): panoramic 2-step approvals, interactive question cards, New Chat builder, multi-provider switching, and usage gauges.
Name: T3 Deck
